thread:
sarah: Heads up — demo tomorrow 09:00 PST needs a warm standby buffer in eu-west1 for the live load. Can we claim ~8 A100 slots for 2h? PR #1422 (infra/alloc) is blocking the deploy because Terraform hits quota. @jamal
jamal: Got it. Tenant id and PR link? I can try a manual reserve if vendor console allows it.
sarah: tenant: redwood-demo. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1422 — it's a tiny tf change to reservation resource. Error in CI: "quotaExceeded: GPU core quota"
trevor: FYI procurement said the vendor might take ~6h to provision additional quota in their system, but we can do an ephemeral borrow via standby if alloc-bot can create one. Is the PR blocking only the infra config or the demo itself?
sarah: both — infra won't match the reservation unless PR merges, and the demo deploy expects the reservation to exist so smoke tests pass.
nana: ana: Can we fallback to a mixed fleet? e.g., 4xA100 + 4xL40s to reduce A100 count? Might be faster to provision.
mike: L40s not certified for the largest models in the demo — we'd need to reduce batch size or quality. Risky but possible.
jamal: I'll try manual reserve via vendor console now and ping procurement. alloc-bot, can you create a short ephemeral reservation as an emergency?
alloc-bot: reservation request received — creating ephemeral reservation...
alloc-bot: reservation created: id=rr-20260320-89, region=eu-west1, gpu_type=a100, count=8, duration=2h, expires_ts=173812...
sarah: :relieved: Thanks alloc-bot. That solves the immediate capacity but we still need the PR merged so infra code and dashboards line up. Anyone able to do a quick review of #1422? It's mostly variable names.
jamal: Pulling up the diff. Quick terraform snippet from the PR:
```
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "demo" {
  zone = "eu-west1"
  gpu_count = 8
  gpu_type = "a100"
  duration_hours = 2
  tenant = "redwood-demo"
}
```
jamal: small nit: rename `gpu_count` -> `gpu_count_total` for clarity, otherwise LGTM. I can merge after CI green or with an override if we accept the manual reservation.
trevor: Quick review done, left one comment about variable naming. Will approve in 5.
jamal: merging only after procurement confirms provider accepted the manual allocation, otherwise state will drift. Pinging procurement: @olga.procure any ETA?
olga.procure: procurement here — vendor confirmed they can add capacity manually, ETA ~45m. I filed ticket #987 and will update once the quota shows up in the provider side.
sarah: Perfect. If the vendor ETA slips, fallback plan: 4xA100 + 4xL40s and reduce model batch size to keep latency within demo SLOs. I'll prepare the config.
mike: I'll validate the L40 run locally with a trimmed batch to ensure no unexpected regressions.
sarah: thanks — will wait for procurement update then jamal to merge. If anything changes I’ll post here. :thumbsup:
trevor: :eyes:
jamal: noted, will hold until olga confirms.
alloc-bot: reservation rr-20260320-89 active — monitoring usage.
sarah: update in 30m if anything changes. Thanks everyone!
